crossRefs.note: If my head is held high, you hunt me like a lion. Again you show yourself powerful to me.
I waited patiently until morning. He breaks all my bones like a lion. From day even to night you will make an end of me.
For I will be to Ephraim like a lion, and like a young lion to the house of Judah. I myself will tear in pieces and go…
“Come! Let’s return to Yahweh; for he has torn us to pieces, and he will heal us; he has injured us, and he will bind…
Therefore I am like a lion to them. Like a leopard, I will lurk by the path.
I will meet them like a bear that is bereaved of her cubs, and will tear the covering of their heart. There I will…
“Woe to you who desire the day of Yahweh! Why do you long for the day of Yahweh? It is darkness, and not light.
He lurks in secret as a lion in his ambush. He lies in wait to catch the helpless. He catches the helpless when he…
He is like a lion that is greedy of his prey, as it were a young lion lurking in secret places.

translations.web: He is to me as a bear lying in wait, as a lion in secret places.
translations.bsb: He is a bear lying in wait, a lion hiding in ambush.
translations.kjv: He was unto me as a bear lying in wait, and as a lion in secret places.
translations.asv: He is unto me as a bear lying in wait, as a lion in secret places.
